title: fix(components): action:group / action:menu stop reading a member's properties.params (objectui#11638)
body:
Fixes #11638

Clause-②: no

## What changes

`action:group` and `action:menu` stop reading a member's `properties.params`. `readMemberStaticParamValues` (in `static-params.ts`) is retired, together with its two calls in the `handleExecute` of `action-group.tsx` and `action-menu.tsx`. Each container now forwards:

- an array `params` as `actionParams` alone, with no static `params` beside it;
- any other `params` through `readActionEntryParamValues`, which is unchanged: a `type: 'api'` member's object `params` is its request payload (the objectstack-ai/objectstack#5777 window), and on any other type an object `params` is dropped with its existing development warning (objectui#10462).

The `useConfigBagEvaluator()` call each of the two containers made existed only for that read, so it is removed with it. `withEvaluatedProperties` stays, because `action:bar` still evaluates an inline member's `properties` for the `action:button` / `action:icon` node it mounts the member on. `readStaticParamValues` (the node path) and `readActionEntryParamValues` are not touched.

No export, prop, type member or i18n key changes. `@object-ui/components` publishes `.` (plus `./style.css`), and its entry does not re-export `static-params`.

## Why

Triage's re-scoped grade on this card (comment `5991243780`): retire `readMemberStaticParamValues`'s `properties.params` read, add no new reading of a member's `params` object, and keep two pins: a member's array `params` still reaches the runner as `actionParams`, and an `action:button`'s `params` object is unchanged. The governing texts behind it:

- the maintainer's ruling A on objectui#10289: "⛔ `params` never carries two shapes, and ⛔ no new value-bag key is declared";
- the spec's member prescription (the `properties` entry of `actionContainerMemberGuidance` in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, objectstack `main`): "A member carries no `properties` bag: its static parameter values (`properties.params`) are not part of the inline action vocabulary. For a `type: 'api'` member's request body write `bodyExtra`; to run an action with static parameter values, author it as its own `action:button` node, whose `params` object carries them."

## Behaviour, before and after (measured by the pins below)

| Member on `action:group` / `action:menu` / `action:bar` overflow | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `properties.params` only | evaluated, forwarded as `params` | not forwarded (`params` undefined) |
| array `params` plus `properties.params` | `actionParams` plus the evaluated static `params` | `actionParams` alone; `params` is only what the user answers |
| `type: 'api'`, object `params` plus `properties.params` | `properties.params` replaced the payload | the object `params` is the payload |
| non-`api`, object `params` | dropped, one development warning | unchanged |
| `action:button` / `action:icon` node with `properties.params` | forwarded | unchanged |
| `action:bar` member drawn inline (mounted on `action:button` / `action:icon`) | forwarded | unchanged |

## Docblocks

Rewritten to cite the spec's member prescription: the `static-params.ts` module header, the `withEvaluatedProperties` docblock (now `action:bar` only), the parenthetical in the `readActionEntryParamValues` docblock, and the `handleExecute` comments in both containers.

Two comments outside the claim's declared file surface said something this change makes false, so they are corrected in the same change (comment-only, no code):

- the overflow note in `action-bar.tsx`'s `renderMember` comment said the `action:menu` evaluates an overflow member's `properties`. It now says the menu reads no member's `properties`, so an overflow member's `properties.params` does not reach the runner;
- the `useConfigBagEvaluator` docblock in `packages/react/src/hooks/useConfigBagEvaluator.ts` named `action:group` / `action:menu` as users of the hook. It now names `action:bar` and says the other two read no member `properties`.

## Writers

Re-measured in this tree at `75c81aa`. No file outside tests authors `properties` on an `action:group` / `action:menu` member:

- `examples/**`, `**/*.stories.*`, `content/docs/**` and `apps/**` (tests excluded): two files name `action:group` or `action:menu`, `content/docs/guide/slotted-pages.md` and `content/docs/layout/page-header.mdx`, and neither authors a member `properties` bag. Control on the same pathspec: 19 files name `action:button`.
- Every non-test `properties.params` mention outside the action renderers (`content/docs/guide/record-edit-modes.md`, `packages/app-shell/README.md`, `AppContent.tsx`, `recordFormNavigation.ts`) teaches it on an `action:button` node, which the prescription keeps. None is changed.
- The hosts that compose `action:bar` / `action:menu` member lists (`ObjectView.tsx`, `InterfaceListPage.tsx`, `EnvironmentListToolbar.tsx`, `DetailView.tsx`, `RecordDetailPanel.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.tsx`, `useNavRunAction.ts`) put no `properties` on a member.

The only authored member `properties.params` was in this package's own objectui#10290 test, re-judged below. No live reproduction is owed, because the key had no writer; the unit pins below carry the proof.

## Tests

`packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-container-member-params-10290.test.tsx`, driven through the real `SchemaRenderer`, the real containers and the real `ActionRunner` on a record page:

- **Kept unchanged:** CONTROL (a top-level `action:button`'s `properties.params` resolves `${record.id}`); "the handler receives `properties.params` with `${record.id}` resolved" on the three `action:bar` inline paths (inline, `component: action:icon`, `component: action:group`), which are the node path; and "a node-level `params` OBJECT is still not a values channel, and says so once" on all eight paths. The parent `describe` is renamed from "a container member's" to "an `action:bar` member's", because the old title is no longer true.
- **Inverted (5 pins):** "the handler receives `properties.params` with `${record.id}` resolved" on the five member paths (`action:bar` with `component: action:menu`, `action:bar` spilled past `maxVisible`, `action:group` inline, `action:group` dropdown, `action:menu`) is now "a member's `properties.params` is not forwarded as static values".
- **New (10 pins), on the same five member paths:** "an array `params` reaches the runner as `actionParams` alone, beside a `properties.params`" and "an `api` member's object `params` is its payload, and a `properties.params` beside it no longer replaces it".
- Unchanged and still green: objectui#10462's `action-entry-object-params-10462.test.tsx` (array leg as `actionParams`, `api` object as payload, non-`api` object dropped), and the `action:button` `properties.params` pins in `action-params-properties-10289.test.tsx`, `action-params-templates-7867.test.tsx`, `action-forward-precedence.test.tsx` and `action-bodyShape-forward.test.tsx`.

**Reverse validation.** With the fix committed (`7d6838d`), the three source files were restored to the base `f1a177c` by `git checkout` and the test file was run. On disk, `readMemberStaticParamValues` was counted 0, then 2, 2 and 1 after the restore, and the blob hashes matched the base. Result: `Tests 15 failed | 12 passed (27)`. All 15 failures were assertion failures (for example, "expected { objectName: 'account', … } to be undefined"), and the 12 node-path and control pins stayed green. Restore: the blob hashes equal `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

**Gates at `75c81aa`** (after merging `origin/main` at `4367146`), each exit code read from its own file:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/`: exit 0, `Test Files 360 passed | 1 skipped (361)`, `Tests 3674 passed | 24 skipped (3698)`
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/react/`: exit 0, `Test Files 108 passed (108)`, `Tests 1400 passed (1400)`
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react type-check`: exit 0, after `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/components^...' build` (exit 0). `tsconfig.test.json` lists the edited test file.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components lint` / `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react lint`: exit 0, 0 errors.
- `pnpm check:action-forward-parity` (exit 0, "5 surfaces checked against 42 runtime-read keys from 4 consumers"), `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:new-line-citations` ("0 new citation(s)"), `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:phantom-deps`: each exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs`: each exit 0.

CI runs the full farm. This change was not measured locally beyond the list above.

## Changeset

`.changeset/11638-member-properties-params-retired.md`, `@object-ui/components: minor`. It is a behaviour change, so it is graded `minor` per this repository's version policy, and the changeset states the change with a FROM/TO.

## Acceptance notes

- **Observation, not filed: `action:bar` inline and overflow now differ for a member that carries `properties.params`.** An inline `action:bar` member is mounted on `action:button` / `action:icon`, whose node reader still reads the bar-evaluated `properties.params`. The same member in the overflow menu reaches `action:menu`, which reads no member `properties`. So for such a member, the `maxVisible` split decides whether static values arrive. No producer was found: `action:bar` is not one of the spec's four `action:*` component rows, and its hosts compose members from registered actions, whose spec schema is strict and declares no `properties`. The ruling names only the member read, so the bar's inline evaluation (`withEvaluatedProperties` in `renderMember`) is left in place. Whether it should also be retired is the seat's call. Pinned both ways in the test file above.
- **The claim's file surface was exceeded** by the two comment-only corrections listed under Docblocks (`action-bar.tsx`, `packages/react/src/hooks/useConfigBagEvaluator.ts`). Both are comments this change made false; no code outside the claimed files changed.
